# ephys-features: `CellReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze ephys-features FILE --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `analyze ephys-features`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/ephys-features.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/ephys-features.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema ephys-features`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | Input path. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id. |
| `trace` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Trace analysed. |
| `channel` | [`ChannelRef`](#channelref) | yes | Channel analysed. |
| `clamp_mode` | `string` | yes | `current_clamp`, `voltage_clamp` or `unknown` (from the channel and command units). |
| `sample_rate_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Sampling rate, Hz. |
| `settings` | [`ApSettings`](#apsettings) | yes | Spike detection settings. |
| `stimulus` | [`StimulusInfo`](#stimulusinfo) or `null` |  | Stimulus from the protocol, when there is one. |
| `cell` | [`CellFeatures`](#cellfeatures) | yes | Per-cell features. |
| `sweeps` | array of [`SweepFeatures`](#sweepfeatures) | yes | One row per sweep. |
| `spike_count_total` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Total spikes detected. |
| `spikes` | array of [`Spike`](#spike) | yes | One row per spike (at most `max_spikes`). |
| `spikes_truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when `spikes` was cut at `max_spikes`. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Remarks. |

## Types

### ChannelRef

The channel analysed.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit as recorded. |

### ApSettings

Detection settings.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `peak_threshold_mv` | `number` (double) | yes | Voltage a spike must cross upward, mV. |
| `dvdt_threshold_v_per_s` | `number` (double) | yes | `dV/dt` defining the onset, V/s. |
| `dvdt_window_samples` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Consecutive samples the onset criterion must hold. |

### StimulusInfo

The stimulus found in the protocol.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `output` | `string` | yes | Command output name. |
| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Command unit. |
| `holding` | `number` (double) | yes | Holding level, in `unit`. |
| `epoch` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Epoch index used as the stimulus. |

### CellFeatures

Per-cell summary.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resting_mv` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median baseline (pre-stimulus) voltage over sweeps, mV. |
| `rheobase_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Smallest depolarising step that evokes at least one spike during the stimulus, pA. |
| `rheobase_sweep` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | The sweep of that step. |
| `fi_curve` | array of [`FiPoint`](#fipoint) | yes | f–I curve over depolarising steps. |
| `fi_slope_hz_per_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Least-squares slope of rate vs current over steps that fire, Hz/pA. |
| `max_firing_rate_hz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Highest firing rate, Hz. |
| `input_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Slope of steady-state deflection vs current over spike-free hyperpolarising steps, MΩ. |
| `tau_ms` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median time constant over hyperpolarising steps, ms. |
| `capacitance_pf` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | τ / R_in, pF. |
| `sag_ratio` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Sag ratio of the most hyperpolarising step. |
| `holding_current_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median holding current, pA (voltage clamp). |
| `access_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median access resistance, MΩ (voltage clamp). |
| `membrane_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median membrane resistance, MΩ (voltage clamp). |
| `membrane_capacitance_pf` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median membrane capacitance from the test pulse, pF (voltage clamp). |

### FiPoint

One point of the f–I curve.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sweep` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Sweep. |
| `current_pa` | `number` (double) | yes | Injected current relative to holding, pA. |

### SweepFeatures

One sweep.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sweep` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Sweep index. |

| `amplitude_mean_mv` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean spike amplitude (peak − onset), mV. |
| `passive` | [`StepResponse`](#stepresponse) or `null` |  | Passive response (current clamp, spike-free sweeps; baseline always). |
| `test_pulse` | [`TestPulse`](#testpulse) or `null` |  | Test-pulse metrics (voltage clamp). |

### StepResponse

Passive response to one current step.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseline_mv` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Baseline voltage, mV. |
| `steady_state_mv` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Steady-state voltage at the end of the step, mV. |
| `extreme_mv` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Extreme voltage during the step (minimum for hyperpolarising steps), mV. |
| `input_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | (steady − baseline) / ΔI, MΩ. |
| `tau_ms` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Membrane time constant, ms. |
| `sag_ratio` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | (steady − min) / (baseline − min) (eFEL sag_ratio1), hyperpolarising steps. |
| `steady_fraction` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | (baseline − steady) / (baseline − min) (eFEL sag_ratio2), hyperpolarising steps. |

Voltage-clamp test-pulse metrics (module docs).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delta_mv` | `number` (double) | yes | Voltage step, mV. |
| `holding_current_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Current before the step, pA. |
| `peak_current_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Transient peak minus baseline, pA. |
| `steady_current_pa` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Steady state minus baseline, pA. |
| `access_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔV / peak, MΩ. |
| `membrane_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔV / steady − access, MΩ. |
| `total_resistance_mohm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔV / steady, MΩ. |
| `tau_ms` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Decay time constant of the transient, ms. |
| `capacitance_pf` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Q/ΔV · ((Ra + Rm)/Rm)² from the transient's charge, pF. |
